product_overview: GradeFlow is a premium academic analytics platform for B.Tech engineering students, combining high-fidelity UI/UX with precise CGPA/SGPA calculation and planning tools. The platform emphasizes “Levitating Liquid Glass” visuals, smooth motion, and reliable student workflow automation.
core_goals: Deliver 100% accurate academic calculations for SGPA, CGPA, and target planning
Preserve premium visual design tokens and motion effects without regressions
Provide fast, responsive, accessible experiences across mobile, tablet, and desktop
Support end-to-end student workflows from landing page discovery to planning and skill matching
Maintain secure authenticated API usage for user-specific academic and career data

features.name: Landing Page Experience
features.description: A premium marketing-style home page that creates a strong first impression with animated hero text, interactive CTAs, stats counters, and visual scanner effects.
user_flows: GET / to load the landing page -> Receive 200 with hero content, animated sections, and CTA elements -> User hovers Initialize Engine button -> Client renders magnetic hover interaction and scanner beam animation
GET / to load the landing page -> Receive 200 with stats section -> User scrolls to stats section -> AnimatedCounter increments smoothly to target values
GET / to load the landing page -> Receive 200 with calculator card -> User hovers calculator card -> Holographic beam effect renders across the card
GET / to load the landing page -> Receive 200 with page shell -> Hero text animation fails to render or appears out of sequence -> Visual regression is detected in animation timing or stagger order

features.name: CGPA Calculator
features.description: A dynamic calculator that lets students enter subject grades and credits to compute SGPA and CGPA with immediate feedback and local persistence.
user_flows: GET /calculator to open the calculator workspace -> Receive 200 with calculator UI -> Enter 4 subjects with grade O and 4 credits each -> SGPA updates to 10.00 accurately

GET /calculator to open the calculator workspace -> Receive 200 with form fields -> Submit with missing grade values -> Inline validation errors appear with premium styling and no calculation is committed
GET /calculator to open the calculator workspace -> Receive 200 with editable grade list -> Change one subject grade -> SGPA HUD updates instantly with glow feedback
GET /calculator to open the calculator workspace -> Receive 200 with saved state UI -> Enter grades and refresh page -> Local storage restores the previous grades and credits

GET /calculator to open the calculator workspace -> Receive 200 with calculator UI -> Enter invalid or incomplete subject inputs -> API-free client calculation shows validation failure and no SGPA result is accepted

features.name: Semester Planner
features.description: A target CGPA planning tool that computes required future academic performance and visualizes the path to graduation goals.
user_flows: GET /planner to open the planning workspace -> Receive 200 with target planner UI -> Set target CGPA to 9.5 -> Planner calculates required SGPA for the remaining semesters
GET /planner to open the planning workspace -> Receive 200 with planning inputs -> Enter past CGPA of 8.0 over 3 semesters -> Backlog Scanner logic identifies required improvement levels
GET /planner to open the planning workspace -> Receive 200 with trajectory chart container -> Open trajectory visualization -> Spline graph renders with glowing path and nodes
GET /planner to open the planning workspace -> Receive 200 with planner UI -> Enter invalid target values outside allowed range -> Validation errors appear and required SGPA is not generated
